notes: AliceSoft System 3.x-3.9: the runtime reads the game's *.ALD files from the game directory, or a game-resource file xsystem35.gr (https://github.com/kichikuou/xsystem35-sdl2/blob/master/doc/xsystem35.6.adoc); System39.ain is System 3.9's bytecode file (https://github.com/kichikuou/xsys35c). .ald is AliceSoft-only in GARbro's table (https://morkt.github.io/GARbro/supported.html).
